title: ICAI Extends MEF 2026-27 Submission Deadline to September 9, 2026
content:
# ICAI Extends MEF 2026-27 Submission Deadline to September 9, 2026

Ek important update hai for all Chartered Accountants! The Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI) ne Multipurpose Empanelment Form (MEF) 2026-27 submit karne ki last date extend kar di hai.

The Professional Development Committee (PDC) of ICAI announced this extension to give members adequate time for submission.

Here are the key details:

*   **Old Due Date:** August 29, 2026
*   **New Due Date:** September 9, 2026
*   **Announcement Date:** August 28, 2026

Please note, the ICAI has clarified that no further extension will be provided for filing MEF 2026-27, as the PDC needs to submit the Bank Branch Auditors' Panel to RBI within the stipulated timeframe.
